Introduction

About Me

I am a vivacious aspiring graduate student at the University of Baltistan, Skardu, looking forward to joining a prestigious institution where I can continue learning and enhancing my skills through advanced studies and research.

I enjoy working both independently and with colleagues, and I bring a genuine, trustworthy, and eager-to-learn approach to every project — from field data collection to GIS-based hazard analysis.

My final year research, "The First Field, Geographic Information System and Remote Sensing Flash-Flood Inventory for District Ghanche, GB Pakistan," reflects my core interest: using spatial science to build climate resilience in mountain communities.

Final Year Research

Field, GIS & Remote Sensing Flash-Flood Inventory for District Ghanche, GB Pakistan

A first-of-its-kind flood inventory combining field verification with GIS and remote sensing techniques to map flash-flood susceptibility across District Ghanche.

Field & GIS Output

Research & Mapping Gallery

Maps and analysis produced for the flash-flood inventory of District Ghanche using ArcGIS, DEM, and remote sensing data.

GIS & Remote Sensing Output

Research & Project Maps

Study Area — District Ghanche

Location overview: world map, Pakistan, GB districts and Ghanche DEM with road network and Shyok River.

District Ghanche DEM & Shyok River

Digital elevation model of Ghanche showing the Shyok River corridor within Gilgit-Baltistan.
